headline: Actor Zaher Alvi surrenders and seeks bail over wife's death
summary: The actor surrendered before a Dhaka court on Thursday after his wife, Afra Ibnat Ikra, died by suicide in February.
details: Actor Niamot Ullah Bhuian, known as Zaher Alvi, surrendered before a Dhaka court on Thursday and applied for bail in connection with a case regarding his wife's death.
His wife, Afra Ibnat Ikra, was found dead by hanging in the couple's Mirpur DOHS flat on February 28. She was rushed to Kurmitola General Hospital, where she was declared dead.
The case was filed by Ikra's father, Kabir Hayat Khan, who alleged that prolonged family disputes and various forms of abuse had driven his daughter to take her own life.
In his bail petition, Alvi denied any involvement in the incident, maintaining that his wife died by suicide.
Alvi had been abroad when the incident occurred and returned to Bangladesh on June 5 following a High Court order for protection from arrest.
Earlier on June 4, Alvi's mother, Nasrin Sultana, had surrendered and secured bail in the same case.
caption:
Actor Zaher Alvi has surrendered to a Dhaka court after his wife died by suicide in February.

Actor Niamot Ullah Bhuian, known as Zaher Alvi, surrendered before a Dhaka court on Thursday and applied for bail in connection with a case regarding his wife's death.

His wife, Afra Ibnat Ikra, was found dead by hanging in the couple's Mirpur DOHS flat on February 28. She was rushed to Kurmitola General Hospital, where she was declared dead.

The case was filed by Ikra's father, Kabir Hayat Khan, who alleged that prolonged family disputes and various forms of abuse had driven his daughter to take her own life.

In his bail petition, Alvi denied any involvement in the incident, maintaining that his wife died by suicide.

Alvi had been abroad when the incident occurred and returned to Bangladesh on June 5 following a High Court order for protection from arrest.

Earlier on June 4, Alvi's mother, Nasrin Sultana, had surrendered and secured bail in the same case.

headline_marked: Munshiganj: [[Scrap trader hacked to death]], motorcycle set on fire
headline: Munshiganj: Scrap trader hacked to death, motorcycle set on fire
summary: Assailants attacked Sohel Munshi at his residence in Louhajang upazila; his bike was torched after the attack.
details: A 39-year-old scrap trader, Sohel Munshi, was hacked to death by unidentified assailants at his residence in Kalurgaon village, Louhajang upazila of Munshiganj.
The attack occurred early today after the victim had gone to bed. Family members were alerted when they noticed a fire in the courtyard and rushed outside to find Sohel's body.
The family alleges that the attackers used sharp weapons to kill him before setting his motorcycle on fire and fleeing the scene.
Police recovered the body and sent it to Munshiganj General Hospital morgue for an autopsy to determine the exact cause of death.
According to police, Sohel was involved in the scrap business and had a drug-related case filed against him in 2022.
Legal proceedings are currently underway as police investigate the motive and identify the suspects.
caption:
A scrap trader was hacked to death at his home in Munshiganj, with his motorcycle set on fire by the attackers.

A 39-year-old scrap trader, Sohel Munshi, was hacked to death by unidentified assailants at his residence in Kalurgaon village, Louhajang upazila of Munshiganj.

The attack occurred early today after the victim had gone to bed. Family members were alerted when they noticed a fire in the courtyard and rushed outside to find Sohel's body.

The family alleges that the attackers used sharp weapons to kill him before setting his motorcycle on fire and fleeing the scene.

Police recovered the body and sent it to Munshiganj General Hospital morgue for an autopsy to determine the exact cause of death.

According to police, Sohel was involved in the scrap business and had a drug-related case filed against him in 2022.

Legal proceedings are currently underway as police investigate the motive and identify the suspects.
